canonical_statement: For an open conjugation-invariant subset V of the complex plane and a real-valued function u harmonic on its strict upper part, continuous on that part together with the real-axis portion of V, and zero on that real-axis portion, the odd reflection is harmonic on V and agrees with u above the axis.
domain_and_universes: V : Set Complex; u : Complex -> Real; Prop in Lean universe 0
hypotheses: forall z, z in V iff starRingEnd Complex z in V
ContinuousOn u (upperPart V union reflectingPart V)
forall z in reflectingPart V, u z = 0
conclusion: The odd reflection is harmonic in a neighborhood of every point of V and agrees with u on the strict upper part.

encoding_decisions.upper_part: z is in V and 0 < z.im
encoding_decisions.reflecting_part: z is in V and z.im = 0
encoding_decisions.odd_reflection: u z when 0 <= z.im, and -u (conj z) otherwise
encoding_decisions.axis_branch: The nonnegative branch selects u on the axis; boundary vanishing makes this equal to its negative reflected value.
encoding_decisions.regularity: HarmonicOnNhd is mathlib's C2 and locally vanishing-Laplacian predicate; continuity is required only on the upper part plus reflecting part.

killed: changed odd reflection to even reflection

degenerate_cases: The target includes the empty open set and domains with an empty reflecting part. It makes no endpoint claim outside V. The entire real-axis portion inside the open set is included, and equality with u is asserted only on the strict upper part.
